## Parts of files
- File name: for example in Beauty.jpg, Beauty is the File name

- File format/extension: for example in Beauty.jpg, .jpg is the extension

## File extensions

### Images
- jpeg
- gif
- tif
- svg
- png

### Video
- mp4
- mov
- avi
- 3gp
- webm

### Audio
- mp3
- au
- ogg
- m4a
- flac

## Data storage

- Flat files
  + .csv (comma separated values)
  + txt - separated by space
  + tsv - tab separated values

- Spreadsheet
  + excel
    + .xls
    + .xlsx
  + ods (OpenDocument Spreadsheet)
  + GoogleSheets

- Databases
  + postgresql
  
- Nested
  + json
